chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan ibn Yahya from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Whoever's dwelling is before the miqat (time/place) to Mecca, let him enter into ihram from his dwelling."
ai.seo_question: Where should a resident of Mecca enter ihram for Hajj if their house is before the miqat?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the specific ruling for Ahl al-Makkah (residents of Mecca), establishing that their home serves as their personal miqat if it lies before the standard boundary. This ruling is derived from the principle that the miqat is the point of departure for those outside, whereas for residents, the limit of their habitation marks the threshold of the sacred precincts. It highlights the flexibility in fiqh al-hajj to accommodate local geography while maintaining the sanctity of the ihram state.
